lens: Recruitment operator — narrow mobile viewport; simulated AI acceptance lens
reason: The public mobile proposition is clear, restrained and consistent with Precision Instrument. Client approval limits are explicit; application materials accurately disclose original-resume access. I traced the implemented operator journey from cohort coverage through results, deliberate grading closure and blocked batch-release recovery. The close dialog visibly separates submitted and valid work, explains irreversible closure, and provides cancellation and retry. Release source identifies outcomes, rechecks the cohort and links blockers to dossiers while separating release from email delivery. However, the earlier attention board can call invalid submitted work Complete, undermining the operator’s triage before irreversible closure. Fix that inconsistency before release. This is source/capture review with local synthetic evidence, not observed operator success or hosted acceptance.

findings.evidence: Coverage is derived solely from assignment statuses at lines 143-150. groupCaseCoverageState in src/app/admin/group-case-coverage.ts:16-25 returns SUBMITTED for two submitted/locked assignments, without evaluating rubric validity. The attention-board row maps that state to Complete at round-board.tsx:314-315 and sorts it after unfinished rows. In contrast, src/lib/group-case-results.ts:roundPrerequisites and the results component explicitly require two valid independent evaluations and retain invalid partial observations.
findings.userImpact: An applicant with two submitted but invalid evaluations appears Complete on the mobile attention cards while still needing valid evidence in results. The operator must reconcile contradictory completion signals before a closure that prevents further grading.
findings.suggestedFix: Label assignment completion explicitly as submissions received, and show canonical valid-evaluator readiness beside it. Prioritize applicants lacking two valid evaluations in the attention list. Add a focused regression for two submitted evaluations that fail rubric prerequisites.

notVerified: No staging, hosted Clerk/Supabase/RLS/storage/email integration, or real operator/human study exists. Local pass counts do not establish those outcomes.
The inspected close capture is synthetic. Its scrollable mobile dialog extends below the initial viewport; tests demonstrate interaction in emulation, not physical-device discoverability.

No supplied authenticated narrow-mobile capture demonstrates the complete cohort/results/release journey. Results use a horizontally scrolling minimum-40rem table; its practical scanning and evidence-review usability remain unobserved.

Safari, Firefox, assistive technology, physical touch targets and session-expiry recovery were not verified. Board resolution of original-resume policy and client approval of project artifacts remain external decisions.
